notes.title: More news about Early Access and new Demo version🚘📢
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you for your patience. I owe you an update.[/p][p]During development, some plans have shifted, which caused delays. Unfortunately, this also means the release has been postponed once more.[/p][p][/p][h3]So, the million-dollar question: [b][i]When is the Early Access release? Is it even coming? [/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The Early Access version is planned & set for [b]after Next Fest, in November[/b]. [b]There will be no more delays.[/b][/p][p]Yeah, it’s a bit late, but it’s coming… [/p][p]and lastly about this subject, I want to clear out want thing: I really, REALLY want to share the game with you, [b]but I don’t want to rush and panic-release it before it’s polished and ready.[/b] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The good news is: on [b]September 16th[/b], I’ll be releasing an [b]updated demo[/b]! [/p][p]The demo will include:[/p][list][*][p]Updated looks of [b]Water Hose 1[/b] and [b]Water Hose 2[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8c75f77b1e2d8b9d1245a04136c70c1d7e766d15.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/af2570ea0b371fac08f7b56aa02b11f8d1646061.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new [b]Washing tool[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8694a0c6228135e08b3d8296208602380af2f106.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The [b]X-RAY feature[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/2ac6540b7c92a444a34db146ba5a92962420afe7.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A [b]new[/b] [b]hand model & animations[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If you already played the prologue version[/b], [b]you can skip this one[/b] and wait for Early Access as it's coming soon. This version is mostly aimed for new players. [/p][p]But if you’d like to try out these new features, give it a go! [/p][p][i][u](Prologue saves won't be compatible)[/u][/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]I’ll also start sharing [b]more in-development updates[/b] on both [b]Discord[/b] and [b]Steam[/b], so keep an eye out.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your support and understanding.[/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to ask. 
[b]I’d really love to hear from you![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Apologies for the unfortunate delay.[/p][p] [/p][p]Love [/p][p]-Yekta[/p]
